description.text: The complete supplied character reference sheet is held as the opening frame, with its full multi-panel layout, dark background, and all existing panel headings and labels kept intact. Across the top, the cinematic panel shows a rain-slick rooftop or industrial catwalk: an adult character with short dark undercut hair, shaved sides, and a small topknot stands upright with arms relaxed, head turned to the side, neutral expression, wearing a black high-collared tactical jacket with straps and buckles over a dark shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots. Metal railings edge the wet platform, rain falls through the cool blue-gray air, and warm amber city lights blur into soft bokeh behind. The middle row presents three full-body turnaround views against a dark neutral studio backdrop, one facing front, one in side profile, and one from the back, each repeating the same slim athletic build and all-black tactical wardrobe under softer directional light. The bottom row contains four tight detail panels showing the face with a scar through one eyebrow on the viewer's left, the jacket collar and its strap hardware, the hands, and the boots. Near-black, charcoal, slate-blue, and warm-amber values keep the sheet low-key and high-contrast, while the studio panels read cooler and cleaner than the rainy rooftop scene. The full sheet remains the visual subject from first moment to last: no panel is isolated, no label is removed, no background is replaced, and the exact arrangement of cinematic image, turnaround views, and detail crops stays in place. The still is brought to life through the slow drifting treatment around this complete frame, so the rain, wet railing, and distant lights retain their existing placement while the image reads as a living version of the same reference sheet.
Opening anchor: the entire composite reference sheet is present, with the cinematic rooftop panel above, the three turnaround views in the middle, and the four detail panels below.
The complete sheet continues to hold together; the rain-slick rooftop setting, the standing figure, the turnaround poses, and the close-up details remain exactly as supplied.
Low-key light keeps cool blue-gray ambient tones across the rooftop and darker neutral studio illumination in the reference panels, while warm amber city lights stay soft in the background.
Near the end, the full layout still reads as one intact sheet, with every existing panel, label, and background area preserved and the character's black tactical wardrobe unchanged.
